import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Ben Green's Open Problem 33

*References:*
- [Gr24] [Ben Green's Open Problem 33](https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/greenbj/papers/open-problems.pdf#problem.33)
- [CaHa20] Caprace, Pierre-Emmanuel, and Pierre de la Harpe. "Groups with irreducibly unfaithful
  subsets for unitary representations." Confluentes Mathematici 12.1 (2020): 31-68.
- [CrLe07] Croot, Ernie, and Vsevolod F. Lev. "Open problems in additive combinatorics."
  Additive combinatorics 43.207-233 (2007): 1.
-/

open Filter
open scoped Pointwise

namespace Green33

/--
Are there infinitely many $q$ for which there is a set $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$,
$|A| = (\sqrt{2} + o(1))q^{1/2}$, with $A + A = \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$? [Gr24]
-/
@[category research open, AMS 5 11]
theorem green_33 :
    answer(sorry) ↔
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        ∃ᶠ q : ℕ+ in atTop,
          ∃ A : Finset (ZMod q),
            A + A = Finset.univ ∧
            |((A.card : ℝ) / Real.sqrt q - Real.sqrt 2)| < ε := by
  sorry

/-- Trivial lower bound: if $A + A = \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$, then $|A|^2 \geq q$,
since the sumset $A + A$ has at most $|A|^2$ elements. -/
@[category test, AMS 5 11]
theorem green_33.sanity_sq_bound (q : ℕ+) (A : Finset (ZMod q))
    (hA : A + A = Finset.univ) : (q : ℕ) ≤ A.card ^ 2 := by
  calc (q : ℕ) = Fintype.card (ZMod q) := (ZMod.card q).symm
    _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).card := Finset.card_univ.symm
    _ = (A + A).card := by rw [hA]
    _ ≤ A.card * A.card := Finset.card_add_le ..
    _ = A.card ^ 2 := (sq A.card).symm

-- TODO(jgd): Add variants from comments in [Gr24]

end Green33

reformulations.difference: The source asks for infinitely many moduli with |A| = (√2 + o(1))√q. Lean instead requires, for every ε > 0, arbitrarily large positive moduli admitting a covering set whose normalized cardinality is within ε of √2.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: For ε_n = 1/(n+1), the Frequently condition permits recursively choosing strictly increasing q_n and sets A_n with A_n+A_n equal to the whole group and normalized-cardinality error below ε_n. Their ratios therefore tend to √2. Conversely, such a strictly increasing sequence is unbounded, and convergence supplies infinitely many witnesses for every positive ε. Since q_n > 0, convergence of |A_n|/√q_n to √2 is exactly the source's little-o cardinality condition. The full equivalence with this sequence formulation was proved in /workspace/review/sequence.lean; /workspace/review/scratch.lean also proves that Frequently atTop on ℕ+ is equivalent to infinitude of the witness set.

https://ecroot.math.gatech.edu/E2S-01-11.pdf — Croot–Lev, Open Problems in Additive Combinatorics, Problem 5.2 and surrounding discussion.

https://arxiv.org/e-print/1807.04992 — LaTeX source, subsections on α(q,m) and the connection to additive combinatorics.

review.notes: Both declarations were checked. Green's online source still presents Problem 33 as open; the prime-modulus and direction-determining questions are separate variants, not missing hypotheses. The positive modulus makes ZMod finite and √q nonzero, and pointwise Finset addition matches the source's unrestricted sumset. Boundary tests excluded empty covering sets, verified covering witnesses at every positive modulus, and exhaustively computed minimum covering-set sizes for q = 1,…,12. The sanity lower bound matches its docstring and depends only on standard Lean axioms, with no sorryAx. All three scratch files compile successfully, and the reviewed file remains byte-for-byte identical to the committed version.
